state.seed_assertion: A DPIA is NOT required where processing was previously found not to be at risk by DPIA.

sentences.1: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar when relying on a previously completed substantially similar DPIA.

s1.instructions: Question about the seed assertion: Does any sentence state why this is done (the reason or the failure it prevents), other than 'the law/regulation requires it'? Does sentences["1"] state the element this question asks for?

criteria.states: The sentence explicitly states the element the question asks for.
criteria.partially: The sentence states part of the element, or states it only implicitly.
criteria.no: The sentence does not state the element; being on the same topic is not enough.
